output_list.criticism: The sell function in the output_list function has an integer overflow, causing an integer overflow in the setPrices function, aka the 'sellPrice' and 'buyPrice' variables are set to 0, allowing an attacker to set any price. This vulnerability can lead to loss of funds for the attacker and potentially damage the reputation of the token.
